t2.thesis: SHOP is a high-quality grower with a large priced-in move (~13.5%), so the earnings reaction is close to a coin flip and I stay near the base rate with a slight reduction for demanding valuation and the software sell-off.
reasons: Base rate for buy-everything is ~54% with a pre-earnings run-up drift in the entry-to-exit window.
Strong fundamentals: 34% revenue growth, rising EPS estimates (+3.6% over 90d), guidance for low-30s growth.
Valuation is rich (forward P/E ~63, P/S ~15) and the stock is already down ~8% over 5 days, leaving mixed positioning.
Software sentiment is fragile (ServiceNow -19% on its print), a risk for high-multiple names.
Implied move of 13.5% is large and symmetric; no skew signal to lean on, and the last 4 prints split 2/2.
t2.deciding_variable: Q4 revenue and GMV growth versus a high bar, and the Q4 guidance on gross profit growth and free cash flow margin.

prior.from: I3 overall validation hit rate 54.2%, BMO 54.8%, software_internet cluster 54.1%; used ~0.54

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. Today is 2026-10-30, so that earnings report on 2026-11-03 hasn't happened yet, and I have no information on how SHOP's stock moved afterward.
t2.moved_from_prior: Moved down about 0.01 from 0.54: rich valuation and weak software read-through offset solid estimate revisions and the strong prior guide.

theses.expected: Rise: GMV and revenue growth hold at 30%+ and the Q4 guide is low-thirties or better, with margin leverage.
theses.mechanism: Consistent beats and AI-commerce narrative drive upward estimate revisions and a relief rally after the pullback.
theses.wrong_if: Gross profit guidance decelerates below mid-twenties or GMV growth falls below 30%.

theses.expected: Fall: results are good but the stock sells off on the high multiple.
theses.mechanism: The software group is derating on AI-disruption fears, and a 13% implied move needs a big beat to be paid.
theses.wrong_if: The stock opens up despite in-line guidance.

theses.expected: Flat to slightly up: a modest beat and in-line guide produce a small move.
theses.mechanism: Implied volatility is more than twice realized volatility, so the realized move often comes in under the implied one.
theses.wrong_if: The open gaps more than 10% in either direction.

key_observations: GMV growth versus the ~30% constant-currency run rate
Q4 gross profit dollar growth guide versus mid-to-high twenties
Free cash flow margin and operating expense ratio
